Intermittent because it only surfaces when the worker.test.ts fork is still alive at timer fire. fixProtocol: Fixture-only fix; every existing assertion stays byte-identical (same test name, body, boundary, headers, single enqueue, 1500ms hang guard, deferred-close delay, assertions).

Make the stream double close-safe: cancelled flag set in cancel() callback; deferred close skips when cancelled and swallows only the already-closed case: let cancelled=false; new ReadableStream<Uint8Array>({start(controller){controller.enqueue(...);setTimeout(()=>{if(cancelled)return;try{controller.close();}catch{/* cancelled by early 422 */}},1000);},cancel(){cancelled=true;}}).
Forbidden: changing assertions, adding sleeps/retries, editing the import route / worker.ts / queue.ts / vitest.config, unref tricks.
